header.newJobHint: Create a job and append it to the queue

summary.label: Workshop load
summary.bookedFridayFree: Workshop booked until {{date}} · {{hours}} h queued · Friday free
summary.bookedFridayBusy: Workshop booked until {{date}} · {{hours}} h queued · Friday {{bufferDate}} already carries work
summary.freeFridayFree: Workshop free · nothing queued · Friday free
summary.freeFridayBusy: Workshop free Monday to Thursday · nothing queued · Friday {{bufferDate}} carries work
summary.bufferHint: Friday is the buffer: it only takes the overflow of work that grew, and it empties itself again as Monday to Thursday frees up.

day.todayHint: Today can still be re-planned in full. Lock the work you have already started.
day.frozenHint: The engine never writes in the past, but you can still edit it by hand.
day.bufferHint: Friday is the buffer: it only takes the overflow of work that grew.
day.weekendHint: Weekend: outside the engine. Manual drag only.

grid.label: Workshop week
grid.bandsLegend: Grey bands: visual margins and lunch — manual drag only
grid.pastLegend: Greyed days: the engine never writes in the past, but you can still edit it by hand
grid.dropRankHint: Dropping sets the block's place in the queue; it then settles right behind the block before it. Lock it to pin it to an exact time.

block.resizeFixedOnly: The duration cannot be changed here: the engine re-lays this block out and it would snap back.
block.resizeAlternatives: To do only part of it today: put another job after it, or use "Stop the day here".
block.drag: Drag to change its place in the queue
block.label: {{name}} · {{day}} · {{start}}–{{end}} · {{hours}} h
block.deleteBody: {{hours}} h will come off "{{name}}" and the job's total will drop to {{total}} h. This cannot be undone.
block.deleteOnlyBlock: This is the job's only block. To remove it, delete the whole job.
block.splitHint: The split-off part takes a place in the queue and then settles; it does not stay at the time you drop it. Lock it if you need it pinned.
block.resizeHint: Enlarging a block takes those hours off the job's last block; shrinking it gives them back. The total does not change.

jobPanel.title: Job
jobPanel.name: Name
jobPanel.totalHoursHint: Raising them adds the hours to the job's last block; lowering them takes the hours off it.
jobPanel.noBlocks: This job has no blocks yet.
jobPanel.deleteBody_one: Its block will be deleted and the calendar will recompose. This cannot be undone.
jobPanel.deleteBody_other: Its {{count}} blocks will be deleted and the calendar will recompose. This cannot be undone.

jobForm.title: New job
jobForm.hint: The job is appended to the end of the queue and fills Monday to Thursday. Friday is the buffer and never takes new jobs.

gapForm.closeDaySpan: It reserves {{start}} to {{end}}: the day loses {{hours}} h of plannable time.
gapForm.closeDayMoves: These hours cannot stay there; the engine replans them:
gapForm.closeDayMovesNone: There is no flexible work after that time: it only reserves the time.
gapForm.closeDayWhole: A job that does not fit in the hours left moves whole to the next day with room.
gapForm.closeDayHint: The gap is what makes the day hold fewer plannable hours. It can be edited or deleted later like any other gap.
gapForm.closeDayLocked: There is locked work inside that stretch ({{names}}): unlock or move it, or the gap cannot be saved.
gapForm.closeDayNoRoom: There is no plannable time left to close at that time.
gapForm.hint: A gap is time: it consumes the day's plannable hours exactly like a locked block. Saving it moves the flexible work out of the way.
gapForm.lunchNote: Lunch is not a gap: it is the space between the two periods of the shift, set in Settings.
gapForm.blockedHint: If the space is held by a locked block, a past day or a weekend, the gap is not saved — unlock or move that block first.
gapForm.deleteBody: {{hours}} h on {{date}} will be freed and the calendar will recompose.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Shift, auto-fill and the look of the calendar.
settings.shiftHint: The shift is split: morning, lunch and afternoon. The space between the two periods is lunch and is never stored as a gap.
settings.period2EnabledHint: Switch it off and the day ends when the morning does; the daily capacity re-caps itself.
settings.shiftTotal: The shift adds up to {{hours}} h.
settings.defaultDayCapacityHint: This is only the stop line for auto-fill: it lets you fill less than the full shift so the shop can close early. It never limits what you place by hand, and it can never exceed the shift. Maximum with the current shift: {{max}} h.
settings.capacityRecapped: Capacity was re-capped to {{hours}} h — that is what the enabled periods add up to.
settings.marginsHint: Grey bands drawn before and after the shift, from {{min}} to {{max}} h. They accept manual drag only: auto-fill never enters them.
settings.timelinePreview: The calendar is drawn from {{start}} to {{end}}.
settings.planningHorizonWeeksHint: Auto-fill never creates blocks beyond this many weeks from today. Between {{min}} and {{max}} weeks.
settings.planningHorizonWarning: If you narrow it and the queued work no longer fits, nothing is saved — neither the horizon nor the rest of the changes.
settings.gapColorHint: Every gap on the calendar is painted this colour.
settings.languageHint: It can be changed at any time and is remembered on this machine.

notices.touchedLockedBlocks_one: One locked block was adjusted because the job had no unlocked hours left.
notices.touchedLockedBlocks_other: {{count}} locked blocks were adjusted because the job had no unlocked hours left.
notices.dropSettles: The block takes the place where you dropped it and settles right behind the one before it. Lock it to pin it to a time.
notices.mergedOverlap_one: It was merged with the block of the same job that was already there. No hours were lost.
notices.mergedOverlap_other: It was merged with {{count}} blocks of the same job that were already there. No hours were lost.
notices.displacedBlocks_one: "{{names}}" was split and its remainder now sits right behind. Move it again if that is not what you wanted.
notices.displacedBlocks_other: {{count}} jobs were split ({{names}}) and their remainders now sit right behind. Move them again if that is not what you wanted.

errors.horizonExceeded: The hours do not fit inside the planning horizon. Widen the horizon in Settings or reduce the hours.
errors.horizonExceededUntil: The hours do not fit before {{date}}, the end of the planning horizon. Widen the horizon in Settings or reduce the hours. Nothing was saved.
errors.invalidDuration: The duration must be greater than zero.
errors.shrinkLastBlock: The job's last block cannot be shortened. Reduce the hours in the job form instead.
errors.transferExceedsJob: The job does not have that many hours in later blocks to give up.
errors.reductionExceedsJob: You cannot remove more hours than the job has.
errors.gapOverLockedBlock: That gap lands on "{{projectName}}", which is locked on {{date}} from {{startTime}} to {{endTime}}. Unlock or move it before saving.
errors.gapOverPastBlock: That gap lands on "{{projectName}}", which is on a past day ({{date}}, {{startTime}} to {{endTime}}). Correct that block by hand before saving.
errors.gapOverWeekendBlock: That gap lands on "{{projectName}}", which is on the weekend ({{date}}, {{startTime}} to {{endTime}}). Move it by hand before saving.
errors.dropOverLockedBlock: That does not fit there: it lands on "{{projectName}}", which is locked on {{date}} from {{startTime}} to {{endTime}}. Unlock it or drop somewhere else. Nothing was saved.
errors.mergeExceedsDay: Merging the two blocks of the same job would not fit inside the day ({{date}}). Drop it earlier. Nothing was saved.
errors.displacedHoursUnplaceable: There is nowhere for the hours "{{projectName}}" has left after that drop. Widen the horizon in Settings or drop somewhere else. Nothing was saved.
errors.invalidPayload: The request could not be read.
errors.invalidColor: That colour is not one of the job swatches.
errors.invalidTotalHours: Total hours must be a number greater than zero.
errors.invalidDate: The date must be in YYYY-MM-DD format.
errors.invalidTime: That time does not fit inside the day.
errors.invalidReason: That gap reason is not valid.
errors.invalidFlag: That value must be true or false.
errors.splitExceedsBlock: The part you are splitting off must be smaller than the block. To move the whole block, drag it.
errors.deleteLastBlock: This is the job's only block. To remove it, delete the whole job.
errors.invariantViolated: The block hours do not add up to the job's hours. Nothing was saved.
errors.settingsInvalid: That setting value is not valid.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Nothing was saved.
errors.loadFailed: The workshop data could not be loaded.
errors.saveFailed: It could not be saved. Nothing was changed.
errors.networkFailed: No connection to the server. Nothing was saved.
errors.notFound: That no longer exists. Reload the calendar.
errors.title: Could not be completed
